reference_sql:
SELECT store_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN order_month = DATE '2025-01-01' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS jan_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN order_month = DATE '2025-02-01' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS feb_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN order_month = DATE '2025-03-01' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS mar_revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY store_code
